Every surviving `aidlc-docs` or `--init` occurrence under docs/ MUST be pinned here by exact file + line text, and the total pinned count MUST stay <= ceiling. The flat `aidlc-docs/` layout and `/aidlc --init` are retired; the ONLY legitimate survivors are: (1) the shipped sensor `matches` glob value `**/{aidlc-docs,intents}/**` (the per-intent record tree, keeping the legacy aidlc-docs arm for a pre-migration project), and (2) one prose line explaining that legacy arm. Adding a new entry requires a visible, reviewable diff here; blanket-allowlisting trips the ceiling. See docs/reference/07-sensor-system.md + docs/harness-engineering/06-sensors.md.
